verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਪੁ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਦਾਲਿਦੀ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਸਦਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: bip sudhaamaa dhaalidhee baal sakhaiee mitrr sadhaae|

en.bdb: Sudama, a poor brahman, was known to be a friend of Krishna from childhood.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਾਗੂ ਹੋਈ ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਦਲਿਦ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਗਵਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: laagoo hoiee baamhanee mil jagadhees dhalidhrr gavaae|

en.bdb: His brahmin wife always pestered him as to why he did not go to Lord Krishna to alleviate his poverty.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਲਿਆ ਗਣਦਾ ਗਟੀਆਂ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਕਉਣੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: chaliaa ganadhaa gaTeeaa(n) kiau kar jaieeaai kaun milaae|

en.bdb: He was perplexed and pondered over how he could get re-introduced to Krishna, who could help him meet the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਹੁਤਾ ਨਗਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਕਾ ਸਿੰਘ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਖਲੋਤਾ ਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: pahutaa nagar dhuaarakaa si(n)gh dhuaar khalotaa jaae|

en.bdb: He reached the town of Duaraka and stood before the main gate (of the palace of Krishna).

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਰਹੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਛਡਿ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: dhoorahu dhekh dda(n)ddaut kar chhadd si(n)ghaasan har jee aae|

en.bdb: Seeing him from a distance, Krishna, the Lord, bowed and leaving his throne came to Sudama.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਦੇ ਪਰਦਖਣਾ ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਕੇ ਲੈ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: pahile dhe paradhakhanaa pairee pai ke lai gal laae|

en.bdb: First he circumambulated around Sudama and then touching his feet he embraced him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਲੈ ਪੈਰ ਧੋਇ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਣੁ ਉਤੇ ਬੈਠਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: charanodhak lai pair dhoi si(n)ghaasan ute baiThaae|

en.bdb: Washing his feet he took that water and made Sudama sit on the throne.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਛੇ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਦੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: puchhe kusal piaar kar gur sevaa dhee kathaa sunaae|

en.bdb: Then Krishna lovingly enquired about his welfare and talked about the time when they were together in the service of the guru (Sandipani).

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਤੰਦੁਲ ਚਬਿਓਨੁ ਵਿਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਅਗੈ ਪਹੁਚਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: lai kai ta(n)dhul chabion vidhaa kare agai pahuchaae|

en.bdb: Krishna asked for the rice sent by Sudama’s wife and after eating, came out to see off his friend Sudama.
Though all the four boons (righteousness,wealth,fulfillment of desire and libereation) were given to Sudama by Krishna, Krishna's humbleness still made him feel totally helpless.
